# Fungua Systems

> Technology solutions, open to everyone. A Nairobi-built technology studio working across data, infrastructure, and software to solve real problems.

Fungua Systems is founded by Jurgens Matika, a Nairobi-based computer scientist with a background in business intelligence, cloud infrastructure, and software development. The studio takes on specific, real problems rather than operating in one fixed product category — current focus areas are data & intelligence, infrastructure & cloud, and software & automation.

The studio is pre-revenue and early-stage as of August 2026: no shipped product yet, one founder, first case study in progress.
